candidates.name: auth_and_budget_guidance
candidates.hypothesis: Adding general API authentication parameter handling guidance and universal step-budget awareness will prevent turning into reverse-engineering rabbit holes and step-budget timeouts, increasing pass rate to 100% on val and reducing wasted turns.
candidates.changes: Added general API guidance in context_mgmt on passing explicit access_token from login and checking doc on 401s; updated agent_loop to nudge on low remaining step budget even when finish_tool is not set.
candidates.expected_efficiency: Saves 10-20 turns on tasks encountering 401s or complex multi-turn execution, decreasing average turns from 20.8 to ~18.
